EXECUTED (Option A) — Differential expression: With KL1–KL3 = UBE2M knockdown and WL1–WL3 = control, the full DE pipeline ran end-to-end in Python (DESeq2 emulation: median-of-ratios size factors ≈ [1.042, 1.042, 0.824, 1.034, 1.084, 1.007]; 5,984 all-zero genes dropped, 15,900 genes tested; per-gene NB GLM with DESeq2-style dispersion trend alpha = 1.734/mean + 0.056, empirical-Bayes MAP dispersion, median alpha = 0.082; Wald test; apeglm-style log2FC shrinkage via adaptive Gaussian-prior MAP, prior sd ≈ 0.86 log2 units). Applying the required filters (p < 0.05, |shrunk log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10) yields 1,521 significant genes: 642 up and 879 down in KD. Real outputs exported: de_table.csv (15,900 genes: baseMean, log2FC, lfcSE, shrunk log2FC, stat, pvalue, padj, dispersion), sig_genes.csv, and ranked_list_for_prerank.csv (shrunk log2FC, descending — ready for gp.prerank).

NOT EXECUTED — GSEApy/KEGG_2019_Mouse prerank: the environment is fully offline (no gseapy, no R, zero .gmt files anywhere on the filesystem, no proxy/mirror, DNS and even raw TCP unreachable), and no Ensembl-mouse→symbol mapping exists locally. No gene sets were fabricated and no GSEA p-values/NES were invented.

ANSWER (inference, explicitly NOT validated by executed GSEA): the most probable most-significantly-enriched KEGG_2019_Mouse pathway in the UBE2M knockdown is Cell cycle (mmu04110). Rationale: UBE2M is the NEDD8-conjugating E2 enzyme; its knockdown impairs cullin-RING-ligase neddylation, causing accumulation of cell-cycle inhibitors and proliferative arrest — canonically reflected in a dominant down-regulation of cell-cycle and DNA-replication genes, which matches the observed DE structure (879 down vs 642 up; the most extreme filtered genes are strongly down in KD, shrunk log2FC down to −6.4, with strong negative Wald statistics), exactly the ranked-list structure that drives a significant negative-NES "Cell cycle" prerank hit. Secondary candidate pathways (same inference class): DNA replication, Ubiquitin mediated proteolysis, and Proteasome. This inference could not be confirmed by the executed analysis because gene identities cannot be mapped offline; only direction/magnitude statistics of the DE genes were verified against UBE2M biology.
